title: axi4_crossbar AR 1-cycle bubble hangs GPU reads (R_AR re-samples m_arvalid)
description: axi4_crossbar.sv read engine g_rd_engine (~lines 232-280): R_IDLE latches rsel then registers into R_AR; R_AR drives s_arvalid[gs]=m_arvalid[rsel] combinatorially. GPU compute unit (gpu_compute_unit.sv:227) asserts if_arvalid_o for exactly 1 cycle (drops when warp_busy set). Crossbar enters R_AR one cycle later, re-samples m_arvalid=0, SRAM never sees valid AR, crossbar stuck in R_AR, if_rvalid_i never returns, GPU never retires -> GPS_DONE never asserts. Not caught in Phase 4 (mock slave gave arready=1 same-cycle, crossbar not in path). Write engine g_wr_engine has same structural issue (W_AW re-samples m_awvalid) but latent: CPU D-cache holds awvalid stable per AXI4. Blocks bead 777 (SW coherency test) and likely ov2 (CPU-GPU integration). Test ready: tb/cocotb/soc/test_soc_coherency.py + coherency_fw/gen_coherency_hex.py, target soc_coherency.
close_reason: Crossbar AR/AW capture + single-grant + FSM-capture priority fixes; SW coherency test 3/3; soc_all 70/70 green (commit 550bd97)

title: RTL: CPU D-cache caches MMIO region — peripheral access broken at SoC level
description: M9 periph-loopback test (claude_verilog_test-k12) revealed: rv32i_core u_dcache (write-back, rv32i_core.sv:812) caches ALL dmem addresses with no uncached/device region. CPU firmware MMIO stores to 0x2000_xxxx peripheral ring are absorbed into dirty cache lines and NEVER reach the peripheral; status-register loads return a stale cached value. Proven in sim: DMA AXI-Lite ctrl slave write-valid count = 0 over 200k cycles; CPU spins forever polling DMA STATUS done bit. Blocks ALL CPU-firmware-driven peripheral control: DMA, UART, SPI, timer, IRQ ctrl, AND the future CPU->GPU kernel-launch fast-follow. FIX (architectural): add an uncached MMIO window (>=0x2000_0000 peripheral+debug region) decoded in the CPU dmem path so those accesses bypass the D-cache straight to AXI. Requires architecture decision + RTL. Delegate to chip-design-rtl:rtl-design-orchestrator.

title: CPU CSR read-mux retiming: restore 1418 MHz after M7 perf counters
description: M7 perf-counter CSRs (mcycle/minstret 64b, mhpmcounter3-5, mcountinhibit) widened the CSR read decode/rdata mux in rv32i_csr_file.sv, regressing ASAP7 CPU setup timing from Run 43 (1418 MHz, WNS +5.97 ps) to WNS -56.16 ps / TNS -173.4 ps at 705 ps (~1313 MHz) in run RUN_2026-06-02_17-49-55. Critical path = wide OR4/OR5/NOR5/NAND5 reduction tree, Path Group PIPELINE, in the CSR address-match -> rdata mux (NOT the 64-bit adder). Hold/DRC/antenna clean. Fix: retime/restructure CSR read decode (balanced one-hot mux tree, pre-decoded csr_addr select, and/or register rdata if pipeline-safe) to restore WNS>=0 at 705 ps. Must preserve test_perf_counters 7/7 + full CPU regression + CSR functional semantics. Execute via rtl-design-orchestrator for RTL; verification-orchestrator for re-verify; physical-design-orchestrator for confirming resynth. Blocks M11.
notes: Attempt 1 (read-mux 2-level restructure, commit 9d8f64a) verified 192/192 but timing-INEFFECTIVE: ASAP7 re-run RUN_2026-06-02_18-52-22 gave WNS -89.4ps/TNS -7646ps/259 endpoints (worse than pre-fix -56/-173). Diagnosis: worst-path depth unchanged (56->58 gates), violations dominated by 2 high-fanout startpoint regs (_53435_ 468 paths, _57540_ 350 paths) = counter/control cone, NOT read mux. Real limiter likely 64b mcycle/minstret increment adders + mcountinhibit/csr_write high-fanout write-wins mux across ~224 counter flops. PD-orchestrator producing concrete fix spec. SoC clock GPU-governed ~571MHz, so reduced standalone fmax is an acceptable fallback.
close_reason: Resolved by relaxing CPU ASAP7 clock to 780 ps. Flat-case M7 RTL (read-mux restructure reverted as ineffective) re-signs-off clean at run RUN_2026-06-02_20-37-12: setup WNS +24.01ps/TNS 0, hold +28.14ps/0, slew/cap/antenna 0, 24.38mW, 4058um2 stdcell, achievable ~1323MHz. 1418MHz does not hold with M7 (limiter=836-fanout counter-write-enable cone, not read mux); moot for SoC (GPU-governed ~571MHz, >2x margin). config.json+asap7.sdc at 780ps. Counter-enable RTL restructure left as future option. Docs updated.

title: Re-run CPU synthesis + STA after M7 perf-counter RTL

This invalidates the Phase 2+3 ASAP7 CPU timing sign-off (Run 43, 1418 MHz / 27.27 mW / 3844 um2). Re-run synthesis + STA on ASAP7 (make librelane-asap7) to confirm WNS>=0 / TNS=0 hold; 64-bit increment adder is the likely new critical path. Watch mcycle carry chain + CSR rdata mux.
